name: loru-player-mobile
description: Loru Player as an Android app: the web build in a Capacitor shell.
author: Rajeev </>
//: The native android/ project is generated by `cap add android` rather than committed, so it always matches the installed Capacitor version.

scripts.add:android: npm run prepare:web && cap add android
scripts.sync: npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
